name: Black Forest Labs
description: Black Forest Labs (BFL) is a frontier AI research and product company with its registered address in Freiburg im Breisgau, Germany. Their mission is to build powerful visual foundation models and tools that let people and organisations generate, control and apply images and video safely at scale, bringing state-of-the-art generative visuals into everyday products and creative workflows.

sources.notes: Black Forest Labs' official imprint lists BFL GmbH's registered address at Ingeborg-Krummer-Schroth-Strasse 18, 79106 Freiburg im Breisgau, Germany.
BFL's official about page describes its labs in Freiburg and San Francisco; the description therefore uses registered address wording rather than a sole-HQ claim.

verification.notes: Location metadata verified; the source supports a registered address and multiple labs, not an exclusive headquarters claim.
